workbook.title: Get Smart Plus 4 Workbook
workbook.prompt: Look and write. Use have to or don't have to.
workbook.observed_content: Phil and Gina's timetable lists get up, make my bed, feed the pets and rake the leaves, with checks and crosses. Pupils write have to / don't have to sentences; activity works without audio.
workbook.rph_match: Y4 L030 optional WB p.15 Activity 3 matches TB p.39 Workbook section, SB p.20 Let's play and main Writing SP 4.3.2.
workbook.notes: Workbook p.15 Activity 1 is a separate listening-and-number task, associated in TB p.39 with Class CD1 Track 30. This audio is NOT a substitute for SB p.20 Activity 2 CD1 Track 29 and is NOT needed for optional WB Activity 3.

prior_workbook_observation.title: Get Smart Plus 4 Workbook
prior_workbook_observation.prompt: Look at the pictures. What do the children have to do?
prior_workbook_observation.observed_content: Six picture-based household duties; pupils write have to + action sentences. Printed example: They have to water the plants.
prior_workbook_observation.rph_match: Lesson 030 optional Workbook p.14 Activity 1 matches original printed task
prior_workbook_observation.notes: This written Workbook activity is separate from the SB p.20 Activity 2 listening task; it does not resolve which recording matches SB p.20. WB p.15 contains a separate Listen and number task and must not be conflated with WB p.14.
prior_workbook_observation.correction: Printed WB p.14 Activity 1 belongs to Unit 2 Our world. A housework theme overlap alone does not establish the Lesson30 Lets play Workbook selection. Teacher's Book p.39 points to WB p.15.

telegram_code_route_check.source: app.py, legacy Year4 media layers v25.257 / v25.258 / v25.259
telegram_code_route_check.finding: All three legacy maps contain Lesson30 -> CD2 Track29 -> Drive file ID 1jndYaX3ysrgEERRYQFFojPLxHuwN35Ob, conflicting with printed TB p39 CD1 Track29.
telegram_code_route_check.consequence: An unguarded Year4 L30 media picker or legacy send could deliver the conflicting CD2 file even though standalone RPH cites CD1.
telegram_code_route_check.protection: web/english_y4_l030_audio_guard.py installed last by tools/run_telegram_with_curriculum_api.py; remove Lesson30 from three legacy maps, hide only media in the picker, and reject stale media requests through both sender variants.
telegram_code_route_check.scope: Year4 Lesson30 media only; all other lessons, RPH Word/PDF, user DB, payments and credits unchanged

audio_signal_comparison.method: librosa.load(...,sr=16000,mono=True) then scipy.signal.fftconvolve(cd2,cd1[::-1],mode='full'); max_abs_crosscorr / sqrt(sum(cd1**2)*sum(cd2**2)). Full decoded streams, no transcript or voice recognition.
audio_signal_comparison.interpretation: CD1 Track29 and CD2 Track29 are NOT merely identical PCM waveforms shifted in time. This acoustic similarity measure cannot verify spoken words or whether the tracks depict the same teaching task with different takes. Correct content remains unverified.
